note:
re-stamped at a branch commit; the previous stamp is not in 19.0-marin.

The count did not move: 1497 measured twice with the CI command
(`npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit`, `grep -c "error TS"`) on clean
detached worktrees of 1f34bb08520 and of this commit, against the 1497 the file
already stored. Only the stamp was wrong. `measured_at` named
2a6841f4ee5ecde65cece7a4a52bf2b6537aa96f, which is not merely absent from
HEAD`s history -- `git cat-file -t` cannot resolve it at all, so the object is
gone from this repository. `_is_ancestor_of_head` returns None for that, not
False, so `--list` rendered it UNCHECKED rather than ORPHANED-BASE and the
enforcing path compared against it as if the base were sound. The delta is
therefore zero and needs no attribution; what needed fixing was that nothing
could check the floor`s freshness.

The note the previous stamp carried, kept because it is the record of how the
count reached 1497 -- 1513 -> 1497, thirteen of the sixteen in the field
widgets, seven of those from one import shadowing the built-in `Record` type --
lives in the history of this file at 2a6841f4ee5 in whatever tree still holds
that commit. THE DURABLE FIGURE IS STILL THE DELTA, NOT THE ABSOLUTE: this
count is whole-repo and reads 1502/1503/1505 on a tree with other sessions`
files open. Re-measure in a detached worktree before concluding anything from
it.
